## 1. Introduction

The package holds the SDTM datasets of FJF-2026-201, a 12-week, randomised, double-blind,
placebo-controlled, parallel-group, dose-finding phase II study of FJF-2026 5, 10, 20 and 40 mg
added to metformin in adults with type 2 diabetes. Datasets are SAS transport v5 files,
described by `define.xml` (Define-XML 2.1). Standards: SDTM 2.0, SDTMIG 3.4, CDISC SDTM
terminology 2024-03-29.

The datasets are made by the SDTM programs of FJF-2026-301 with this study's protocol
(`docs/protocols/fjf-2026-201.yml`) and specification (`docs/specs/sdtm-201.yml`), and the same
cleaning rules (`docs/specs/cleaning-rules.yml`); see ADR 0030. No program is specific to this
study.

## 2. Protocol description

Five arms, 1:1:1:1:1, stratified by screening HbA1c (≤ 8.5%, > 8.5%): placebo and FJF-2026 5,
10, 20 and 40 mg, each added to metformin, double-dummy (two tablets a day for every patient).
Screening (2 weeks), treatment (12 weeks), follow-up (2 weeks). The visits are at screening,
randomisation and weeks 2, 4, 8, 12 and 14. The trial design is in TA, TE, TV, TI and TS; each
subject's path is in SE.

## 3. Subject data description

### Domains

The domains and their content are those of FJF-2026-301 (its guide, section 3):

| Dataset | Records | Notes |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| DM | 575 | 475 randomised and 100 screen failures (ARMNRS = SCREEN FAILURE). |
| DS | 2,100 | Protocol milestones and disposition events. |
| IE | 100 | Screen failures only, from the criterion recorded on the CRF. |
| SV | 3,311 | Unscheduled visits numbered after the previous planned visit (+ 0.1). |
| SE | 1,518 | Screening, treatment, follow-up; EPOCH of every other domain comes from SE. |
| EX, DA | 1,350; 2,700 | One EX record per bottle; tablet counts in DA. |
| CM | 492 | Background therapy and rescue medication (CMCAT). |
| AE, SUPPAE | 409; 6 | SUPPAE.AEENRAW holds end dates set aside by rule CR08. |
| CE, SUPPCE | 30; 60 | Hypoglycaemic events: ADA level in CESCAT; glucose and assistance in SUPPCE. |
| LB, VS | 13,454; 11,976 | Standard units by fixed factors; height from the screening demography page. |

TS states the phase (PHASE II TRIAL), the primary objective (the dose-response and the dose to
take forward) and two secondary objectives (robustness of the dose-response, safety by dose).

### Coding dictionaries, data not collected, cleaning rules

As in FJF-2026-301: the project's reduced dictionary in place of MedDRA and WHODrug (no codes),
COUNTRY, seriousness criteria and the demography of screen failures not collected, and the
cleaning rules CR01 to CR08 applied in SDTM, every touched record listed in the data-issues
listing.

### Blinding

The database is locked (tag `dblock-201`) and the reviewer authorised the unblinding
(`docs/unblind/unblind-201.yml`, ADR 0032). The arm of each subject in DM, SE and EX is the real
one. Before the unblinding, the same programs ran on a dummy assignment (the real arms shuffled
within stratum with a public seed, ADR 0027); only the treatment variables changed.

## 4. Data conformance summary

Pinnacle 21 Community 2304.3 (SDTM-IG 3.4, FDA) reports 19 rules, all among those FJF-2026-301
reports and explains; no rule is new. CDISC CORE v1.0.0 reports the same 26 rules as for
FJF-2026-301. The second programming of FJF-2026-301 (`qc/301/sdtm_qc.R`), run on this study's
raw data, agrees with production in all ten domains it covers. Details are in
`studies/201/conformance.md`.
